LanguageData.TMM.Deathrest.Help: A guest with an active deathrest gene may rest in their paid roofed room. Before starting, they need enough silver for normal daily accommodation over a full cycle (usually 4 days). Their group waits until they wake. A guest casket provides its native speed bonus if temporary binding is available; other equipment keeps its existing bindings. Completed guests wake automatically. Nonpayment, an unsafe/lost room or ending the visit interrupts sleep with the native consequence. Disabling this option prevents new cycles and preserves current ones.
LanguageData.TMM.Deathrest.None: No hotel guest is currently deathresting.
LanguageData.TMM.Deathrest.Interrupt: Interrupt deathrest for {0}? An incomplete cycle causes the normal Interrupted deathrest effect and resets cycle progress.
